content:
John has 10 hectares of pineapple field, with 100 pineapples per hectare. So, in one harvest, he gets:
10 hectares × 100 pineapples/hectare = 1000 pineapples.

He can harvest every 3 months. In one year (12 months), the number of harvests is:
12 months ÷ 3 months/harvest = 4 harvests.

Total pineapples harvested in a year:
1000 pineapples/harvest × 4 harvests = 4000 pineapples.

Answer: 4000
